subject: Multi-instrumentalist creative collective and current lo-fi rhythm language
question: Owner-initiated correction of fixed instrumental chairs
decision: Organize the band as multi-instrumentalist creatives working mostly within related instrument classes, with shifting roles based on what the song needs. The group explores context to compose a DKC-reminiscent soundtrack with advanced tools. Add a traditional percussionist; world drum kits are reported available in the current configuration. Lo-fi beats are an underlying theme for the current time, with a metal-style kit not the current rhythmic default. Detailed proposed capabilities, references and exact presets remain review choices.
